# Welcome to Vacation Station 14
You're on a casual SS14 hangout server. Light roleplay, creativity over violence, and a chosen-family vibe where players share the space and take care of it together. SFW, 16+, hub-listed via the Wizards' Den.
If this is your first time on SS14 entirely, the upstream [textlink="New? Start here!" link="NewPlayer"/] page covers basic controls, the shuttle terminal, and how a round flows. The pages in this section are about VS14 specifically.
## The short version
- [bold]Light RP.[/bold] Try to act like your character would. The bar is "make some effort," not "pristine RP." See [textlink="Server Etiquette" link="VSEtiquette"/]. - [bold]No griefing, no NSFW.[/bold] The full rules live under [textlink="Server Rules" link="DefaultRuleset"/]. Worth a skim. - [bold]Need help mid-round?[/bold] Press [color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenAHelp"][/bold][/color] to ahelp. Details in [textlink="How to Ahelp" link="VSAHelp"/]. - [bold]Not sure what your job does?[/bold] [textlink="Roles at a Glance" link="VSRoles"/] covers the major departments.
## A few useful keys
- [color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenAHelp"][/bold][/color] — admin help - [color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenCharacterMenu"][/bold][/color] — character menu - [color=yellow][bold][keybind="OpenGuidebook"][/bold][/color] — reopen this guidebook anytime - [color=yellow][bold][keybind="ExamineEntity"][/bold][/color] — examine something you're hovering over
